**Registration is open.** Registration and payment run through the ETH Zürich event registration platform.

[Register now →](https://ethzurich.eventsair.com/2nd-perit-summit/regi/Site/Register){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}

The Peritoneal Summit is kept deliberately intimate — **around 90 participants** — to encourage genuine exchange across disciplines.

## Key dates

| Date | Milestone |
|---|---|
| **Now open** | Registration |
| **15 June 2027** | Abstract submission deadline · early-bird registration closes |
| **Early July 2027** | Abstract decisions communicated |
| **Mid-August 2027** | Accommodation booking deadline — limited rooms at the venue, book early |
| **Until the conference** | Regular registration remains open, subject to capacity |

### Accommodation
<p class="price-tbd">Booked through us, paid at arrival</p>
Per night · at the conference venue
- Conference rate, breakfast included
- Book your room when you register
- Paid at the hotel on arrival
- Walking distance from sessions
- Limited availability — book early
:::

:::

All prices in CHF, including VAT. The early-bird rate applies until **15 June 2027**; the regular rate applies from 16 June 2027 until the Summit, subject to capacity. Accommodation is not included in the conference packages. You can book a room at Hotel Seaside as part of your registration: you pay the conference package online when you register, and the hotel directly on arrival.

## Questions

For questions about registration, contact the organizers (see [Contact](contact.qmd)).
